trap.label: preposição
trap.wrong: Thank you by your quotation of May 3.
trap.right: Thank you for your quotation of May 3.
trap.why: Em português “agradeço pela” traduz-se com by ou with. Em inglês, thank you for + substantivo/-ing.

mcq.q: “___ we value your offer, the price is high.”
“Should you be ___ to confirm, we would order.”
“In ___, we would commit to a two-year contract.”

fix.wrong: Should you can confirm, we would order.
fix.right: Should you be able to confirm, we would order.

fix.wrong: We would commit for a two-year contract.
fix.right: We would commit to a two-year contract.

fix.wrong: Much as we value the discount, but the price is high.
fix.right: Much as we value the discount, the price is high.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Should: “If you are able to confirm, we would order.”
rewrite.answer: Should you be able to confirm, we would order.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Much as: “Although we value your offer, the price is high.”
rewrite.answer: Much as we value your offer, the price is high.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com thank you for: “I thank you the quotation.”
